sections.heading: Answer First
sections.situation: Phase 121 upgrades the chronicle context model while keeping v3.1 fixtures valid.
sections.question: How can the builder emit richer answer-first context without making old fixtures invalid?

sections.body: The builder is the enforcement point for answer-first chronicle fields.
